title: exec-staff-meeting-prep-notes-2026-03-13
content:
Purpose: quick sync to align on launch readiness for Dedicated Q2 pilot, risk/mitigation, headcount ask, and cross-org blockers. Keep to 45 min.

Meeting logistics:
- Date/time: 2026-03-13 09:00-09:45 PT
- Attendees (requested): Priya (chair), Alex (CTO), Jordan (VP Eng), Sofia (Head of Product Ops), Miguel (SRE), Dana (Finance)
- Pre-reads: Exec staff deck (Confluence link above), Dedicated pilot runbook (internal), capacity cost forecast (sheet link in Slack)

Agenda (rough, keep tight):
1) 9:00-9:05 — Quick wins & updates (Priya) — 2 bullet highlights since last week
2) 9:05-9:20 — Dedicated pilot readiness (Jordan + Alex) — infra capacity, SLA gating, rollout plan
3) 9:20-9:30 — GTM plan and customer selection (Sofia) — target accounts, sales enablement, pricing ask
4) 9:30-9:37 — Risk review & mitigation (Miguel + Dana) — cost delta, security checklist, compliance timeline
5) 9:37-9:45 — Decisions needed & action items (Priya) — clear owners and due dates

Key talking points / notes to call out:
- Dedicated Q2 pilot status: dev env stable; end-to-end tests pass for 2/3 workload patterns. Remaining: memory/regression on long-context (>8k) models (tracked in GH PR #4821).
- Capacity ask: initial reserved pool of 8 GPUs in us-west-2 for pilot (2 p95 windows of demand). Finance indicates Opex hit acceptable if pilot converts. Need final signoff from Dana this week.
- SLA gating: propose soft SLA for pilot (99.5% uptime, 200ms p50 for gen workloads) — ops to confirm feasibility. If ops flag shows risk, propose staggered SLA tiers for pilot customers.
- Customer selection: shortlist of 6 SOC2-ready accounts; recommend 3 for day-1 pilot (mix of SaaS/marketplace/enterprise). Sales lead assigned: Maya. Need marketing one-pager and technical onboarding doc ready by Mar 17.
- Security/compliance: Private deployment checklist almost complete; 2 open items: HSM integration test and audit log export format. Compliance team estimates 10 business days to validate once HSM test passes.

Metrics snapshot to share (prep numbers — will update with final prior to meeting):
- Hosted API p50 latency (gen): 180 ms
- Hosted API p95 latency (gen): 420 ms
- Cost per 1k tokens (hosted): $0.09
- Current Dedicated beta pipeline MRR pipeline: $240k

Open questions / asks for execs to be prepared to decide:
- Approve the 8-GPU reserved capacity for pilot (yes/no) — finance signoff required before provisioning.
- Approve soft SLA and customer segmentation for pilot (tiered SLA for early customers)?
- Headcount: approve 1 SRE contractor (3 months) + 0.5 FTE onboarding engineer for pilot (start Apr) — will impact runbook support.

Risks & mitigations (short):
- Risk: long-context regression could block some pilot customers. Mitigation: offer reduced context or model variant; two-week triage sprint with applied-ml team.
- Risk: HSM test delay delaying Private deployment. Mitigation: ship pilot without HSM for hosted/dedicated customers; prioritise HSM for Private signups.
- Risk: Cost overrun if usage spikes. Mitigation: burst policy + auto-fallback to cheaper model variant + budget guardrails in Console.

Draft decisions slide (what I want to land in meeting):
- Green-light 8-GPU reserve for pilot (assign Dana to sign off by 2026-03-15)
- Approve soft SLA for pilot customers and tiered escalation policy
- Approve hiring request (SRE contractor + 0.5 FTE onboarding) — Raj/People ops to start requisition

Action items (to track after meeting) — make owners explicit and dates: (format: task / owner / due)
- Finalize Reserved GPU PO and confirm billing impact / Dana / 2026-03-15
- Complete HSM integration smoke test / Alex / 2026-03-20
- Prepare pilot onboarding one-pager + tech runbook / Sofia + Maya / 2026-03-17
- Triage long-context regression and deliver patch or roll plan / Jordan + Applied-ML (Alex) / 2026-03-19
- Update Console budget guardrails and create alert for pilot customers / Miguel / 2026-03-18
- Draft customer comms for pilot (expectations + SLA) / Priya + Sales / 2026-03-16

Notes to self (for running the meeting):
- Keep discussion decision-focused; surface blockers only if they change timeline materially.
- If capacity ask gets pushback, offer two options: (A) smaller 4-GPU pilot with tighter customer curation, or (B) full 8-GPU with finance pre-approval and a hard usage cap.
- Bring the triage owner for long-context regression into the thread if asked (Jordan).

Post-meeting follow-up plan:
- Send meeting notes + decisions + action item table within 24 hrs (I will distribute and tag owners).
- Create Jira epic for pilot execution with linked tickets for infra, runbook, security, and GTM (owner: Sofia).

Scratch/brainstorm (if asked):
- Consider offering a low-cost early adopter tier with reduced support and lower SLA in exchange for long-term commit (helps convert pilot to contract).
- Explore partner credits for GPU to offset initial costs during pilot window.

Quick personal reminders: finalize slide 3 (pilot timeline) and include cost delta table; confirm Dana availability before meeting; ping Raj to pre-approve hiring req doc.

End of notes.
